description: Collision guard: one config with an ALIAS record (contributes alias.zone_id -> ALB) AND a standalone zone_association (needs zone_id -> zone). infra reuses one mock per attribute name, so record.zone_id, record.alias.zone_id and association.zone_id all share the SAME mock value while referencing different targets (zone vs ALB). ReferenceResolver.valueToId gives real (top-level) attributes priority so the flattened alias.zone_id can't poison the zone alias; the standalone zone->VPC-b edge survives. Expect 2 route53-zone-vpc edges (inline VPC a + association VPC b) and 1 route53-alias edge (record -> ALB).
